scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=external --target=bun --outfile=dist/tprocs src/index.tsx
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && ln -sf "$PWD/dist/tprocs" "$HOME/.local/bin/tprocs" && echo "installed: $HOME/.local/bin/tprocs -> $PWD/dist/tprocs" && (echo $PATH | tr : '\n' | grep -qx "$HOME/.local/bin" || echo "warning: $HOME/.local/bin is not on PATH. add this to your shell rc: export PATH=\"$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH\"")
scripts.build:all: bun run clean && bun run build:darwin-arm64 && bun run build:darwin-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:windows-x64
